notes: Three taḥwīl branches. The names written once after the last «ح» (Qais, then al-Mughira, the Companion who heard the Prophet) belong to every branch, so they are the shared tail (rule 3).
Dashed glosses «- واللفظ له -» and «- يعني الفزاري -» are left out. «كلاهما عن إسماعيل بن أبي خالد» joins Waki and Abda into one level.
The first branch writes no names after Waki before the taḥwīl; it takes the tail as the text writes it once. This is a reading to check against the other readers.
